newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March PSBR seen around 15 trln lire - paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy March PSBR seen around 15 trln lire - paper.

text.p: Italy's March public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) is seen around 15 trillion lire ($8.8 billion) compared to 19 trillion in March 1996, the financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore reported on Tuesday.
The paper warned that this March figure was based on provisional estimates and was susceptible to correction.
On Monday, the Italian Treasury said Italy's PSBR was around 6.5 trillion lire in January and February 1997 compared with around 25.71 trillion for the same two-month period last year.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi added on Monday that Italy's PSBR over the first two months of the year was in line with government targets, but fresh budget action would still be needed this year.
Il Sole said a 1997 mini-budget would be needed for between 15 and 23 trillion lire, while Prime Minister Romano Prodi has indicated a mini-budget of between six and 14.5 trillion lire.
